entries.not_relevant_because: All seven manuscripts concern the anticanonical side: nonvanishing of H^0(X,-mK_X) (or of a positive multiple of -(K_W+D)) under semipositivity or nefness of -K_X; none proves that a nef K_X on a klt variety is semiample. The only semiampleness step touching a nef adjoint is in Integrable-metrics-and-effectivity-with-controlled-boundary (fano-auxiliary, the model theorem), where a klt pair with big boundary and nef K+Delta is made semiample by citing BCHM Corollary 3.9.2 as an input to a Fano-type model construction; that is a cited known result, not a claim about abundance.
read: grep over the build/source trees of all seven manuscripts for theorem statements and for abundance, semiample, Iitaka, nef, and K_X-sign terms (theorem statements of Invariant-anticanonical-indices, Bounded-anticanonical-metrics, Metric-descent, Integrable-metrics, Exact-orders were located by grep, not read in full)
